40021776.author: पदार्थः
40021776.content: लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, दारुणम् harsh, जनकात्मजा the daughter of Janaka, परम् extreme, विषादम् sorrow, आगम्य having obtained, वैदेही Vaidehi, निपपात fell down, ह indeed.

40021776.author: Translation
40021776.content: Having heard Lakshmana's harsh words, Sita, the daughter of Janaka, was overcome with extreme sorrow and fell to the ground.

40021777.author: पदार्थः
40021777.content: सा she, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, इव as if, असञ्ज्ञा unconscious, बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा with eyes agitated by tears, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, दीनया with a piteous, वाचा voice, उवाच spoke, जनकात्मजा the daughter of Janaka.

40021777.author: Translation
40021777.content: For a moment, she lay as if unconscious, her eyes agitated with tears, and then the daughter of Janaka spoke to Lakshmana in a piteous voice.

40021778.author: पदार्थः
40021778.content: मामिकेयम् this my, तनुः body, नूनम् surely, सृष्टा created, दुःखाय for sorrow, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, धात्रा by the creator, यस्याः whose, तथा thus, मे my, अद्य today, दुःखमूर्तिः the very embodiment of sorrow, प्रदृश्यते is seen.

40021778.author: Translation
40021778.content: O Lakshmana, this body of mine was surely created by the creator for sorrow, as today it appears to me as the very embodiment of suffering.

40021779.author: पदार्थः
40021779.content: किं what, नु indeed, पापं sin, कृतं done, पूर्वं previously, को who, वा or, दारैः from wives, वियोजितः separated, या who, अहं I, शुद्धसमाचारा of pure conduct, त्यक्ता abandoned, नृपतिना by the king, सती a chaste woman.

40021779.author: Translation
40021779.content: What sin did I commit previously, or whom did I separate from his wife, that I, a chaste woman of pure conduct, have been abandoned by the king?

40021780.author: पदार्थः
40021780.content: पुरा formerly, अहं I, आश्रमे in the hermitage, वासं dwelling, रामपादानुवर्तिनी following Rama's feet, अनुरुध्यापि even though I followed, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, दुःखे in sorrow, च and, परिवर्तिनी remaining.

40021780.author: Translation
40021780.content: O son of Sumitra, formerly I dwelt in the hermitage, devoted to Rama, and even though I followed him, I remained in sorrow.

40021781.author: पदार्थः
40021781.content: सा such a one, कथं how, हि indeed, आश्रमे in the hermitage, सौम्य O gentle one, वत्स्यामि shall I live, विजनीकृता made desolate, आख्यास्यामि shall I tell, च and, कस्य to whom, अहं I, दुःखं sorrow, दुःखपरायणा full of sorrow.

40021781.author: Translation
40021781.content: O gentle one, how shall I, made desolate, indeed live in the hermitage, and to whom shall I, full of sorrow, tell my grief?

40021782.author: पदार्थः
40021782.content: किं what, नु indeed, वक्ष्यामि shall I say, मुनिषु among the sages, कर्म deed, वा or, सत्कृतं good, च and, किम् what, कस्मिंश्चित् for some, कारणे reason, त्यक्ता abandoned, राघवेण by Raghava, महात्मना by the great-souled one.

40021782.author: Translation
40021782.content: What indeed shall I say among the sages, or what good deed have I done, that I have been abandoned by the great-souled Raghava for some reason?

40021783.author: पदार्थः
40021783.content: न not, खलु indeed, अद्यैव just today, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, जीवितं life, जाह्नवीजले in the waters of the Ganga, त्यजेयं I would abandon, राजवंशः the royal lineage, तु but, भर्तुः of my husband, मे my, परिहास्यते will be ridiculed.

40021783.author: Translation
40021783.content: O son of Sumitra, I would indeed not abandon my life in the waters of the Ganga just today, but my husband's royal lineage would be ridiculed.

40021784.author: पदार्थः
40021784.content: यथाज्ञं as commanded, कुरु do, सोमित्रे O son of Sumitra, त्यज abandon, मां me, दुःखभागिनीम् one destined for sorrow, निदेशे in the command, स्थीयतां remain, राज्ञः of the king, शृणु listen, च and, इदं this, वचो word, मम my.

40021784.author: Translation
40021784.content: O Lakshmana, do as commanded, abandon me, who is destined for sorrow, remain steadfast in the king's command, and listen to these words of mine.

40021785.author: पदार्थः
40021785.content: श्वश्रूणाम् of the mothers-in-law, अविशेषेण without distinction, प्राञ्जलिप्रग्रहेण with folded hands and reverence, च and, शिरसा with the head, आवन्द्य having bowed down, चरणौ the feet, कुशलं well-being, ब्रूहि tell, पार्थिवम् to the king.

40021785.author: Translation
40021785.content: Convey my respects to all mothers-in-law without distinction, and bowing down to the king's feet with folded hands and reverence, tell him of my well-being.

40021786.author: पदार्थः
40021786.content: शिरसा with the head, अभिनतो having bowed down, ब्रूयाः you should say, सर्वासाम् of all, एव indeed, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, वक्तव्यः should be told, च and, अपि also, नृपतिः the king, धर्मेषु in duties, सुसमाहितः well-focused.

40021786.author: Translation
40021786.content: O Lakshmana, you should convey my respects to all (mothers-in-law) by bowing your head, and also tell the king to remain steadfast in his duties of righteousness.

40021787.author: पदार्थः
40021787.content: जानासि you know, च and, यथा how, शुद्धा pure, सीता Sita, तत्त्वेन in reality, राघव O Rama, भक्त्या with devotion, च and, परया supreme, युक्ता endowed, हिता beneficial, च and, तव to you, नित्यशः always.

40021787.author: Translation
40021787.content: O Rama, you truly know how pure Sita is, and how she is always endowed with supreme devotion and is beneficial to you.

40021788.author: पदार्थः
40021788.content: अहं I, त्यक्ता abandoned, त्वया by you, वीर O hero, अयशोभीरुणा by one fearful of ill-repute, जने among people, यत् whatever, च and, ते to you, वचनीयं blame, स्यात् may be, अपवादसमुत्थितम् arising from slander, मया by me, च and, परिहर्तव्यं should be endured, त्वं you, हि indeed, मे my, परमा ultimate, गतिः refuge.

40021788.author: Translation
40021788.content: O hero, I have been abandoned by you, who fears ill-repute among people; whatever blame arises from public criticism, I shall endure it, for you are indeed my ultimate refuge.

40021789.author: पदार्थः
40021789.content: वक्तव्यः should be told, च and, इति thus, नृपतिः the king, धर्मेण righteously, सुसमाहितः well-composed, यथा as, भ्रातृषु towards brothers, वर्तेथाः you should behave, तथा similarly, पौरेषु towards citizens, नित्यदा always.

40021789.author: Translation
40021789.content: The king should be told, with a composed mind and righteously, that he should always behave towards his citizens just as he behaves towards his brothers.

40021790.author: पदार्थः
40021790.content: परमः supreme, हि indeed, एषः this, धर्मः duty, ते your, तस्मात् therefore, कीर्तिः fame, अनुत्तमा unsurpassed.

40021790.author: Translation
40021790.content: Indeed, this is your supreme duty, and from it comes unsurpassed fame.

40021791.author: पदार्थः
40021791.content: यत् what, तु but, पौरजनः the citizens, राजन् O King, धर्मेण righteously, समवाप्नुयात् may obtain, अहम् I, तु but, न not, अनुशोचामि grieve for, स्वशरीरम् my own body, नरर्षभ O best among men.

40021791.author: Translation
40021791.content: O King, whatever the citizens may righteously obtain, I, O best among men, do not grieve for my own body.

40021792.author: पदार्थः
40021792.content: यथापवादम् according to the slander, पौराणाम् of the citizens, तथैव similarly, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, पतिः husband, हि indeed, देवता deity, नार्याः of a woman, पतिः husband, बन्धुः relative, पतिः husband, गुरुः preceptor.

40021792.author: Translation
40021792.content: O delight of the Raghus, act according to the citizens' slander, for indeed, a husband is a woman's deity, her relative, and her preceptor.

40021793.author: पदार्थः
40021793.content: प्राणैः than life, अपि even, प्रियम् dear, तस्मात् therefore, भर्तुः of the husband, कार्यम् duty, विशेषतः especially, इति thus, मद्वचनात् from my words, रामः Rama, वक्तव्यः should be told, मम my, सङ्ग्रहः message, निरीक्ष्य having seen, मा me, अद्य today, गच्छ go, त्वम् you, ऋतुकलातिवर्तिनीम् one who has passed the time of menstruation.

40021793.author: Translation
40021793.content: Therefore, the husband's duty is dearer even than life, and thus, Rama should be told this message from me: "Having seen me today, who has passed the time of menstruation (i.e., pregnant), you may go."

40021794.author: पदार्थः
40021794.content: एवं thus, ब्रुवन्त्यां while speaking, सीतायां Sita, लक्ष्मणो Lakshmana, दीनचेतनः with a sorrowful mind, शिरसा with his head, आवन्द्य having bowed down, धरणीं to the earth, व्याहर्तुं to speak, न not, शशाक was able, ह indeed.

40021794.author: Translation
40021794.content: While Sita was speaking thus, Lakshmana, with a distressed mind, bowed his head to the earth and was unable to utter a word.

40021795.author: पदार्थः
40021795.content: प्रदक्षिणं circumambulation, च and, तां her, कृत्वा having done, रुदन्नेव weeping indeed, महास्वनः with a loud sound, ध्यात्वा having thought, मुहूर्तं for a moment, तामाह to her he said, किं what, मां to me, वक्ष्यसि will you say, शोभने O beautiful one.

40021795.author: Translation
40021795.content: Having circumambulated her and weeping loudly, he pondered for a moment and then said to her, "O beautiful one, what will you say to me?"

40021796.author: पदार्थः
40021796.content: दृष्टपूर्वं seen before, न not, ते your, रूपं form, पादौ feet, दृष्टौ seen, तवानघे your, O sinless one, कथम् how, अत्र here, हि indeed, पश्यामि I see, रामेण by Rama, रहितां separated, वने in the forest.

40021796.author: Translation
40021796.content: "Your face has never been seen by me before, only your feet, O sinless one; how then can I look upon you here in the forest, separated from Rama?"

40021797.author: पदार्थः
40021797.content: इत्युक्त्वा having said thus, तां her, नमस्कृत्य having saluted, पुनर् again, नावम् boat, उपारुहत् he ascended, आरुह्य having boarded, च and, पुनर् again, नावम् boat, नाविकं boatman, च and, अभ्यचोदयत् he urged.

40021797.author: Translation
40021797.content: Having spoken thus and saluted her, he boarded the boat again, and having re-boarded the boat, he urged the boatman to proceed.

40021798.author: पदार्थः
40021798.content: स he, गत्वा having gone, च and, उत्तरं northern, तीरं bank, शोकभारसमन्वितः overwhelmed by the burden of sorrow, सम्मूढ bewildered, इव as if, दुःखेन by sorrow, रथम् chariot, अध्यारुहत् he ascended, द्रुतम् quickly.

40021798.author: Translation
40021798.content: Having reached the northern bank, he, overwhelmed by the burden of sorrow and as if bewildered by distress, quickly mounted the chariot.

40021799.author: पदार्थः
40021799.content: मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, परावृत्य having turned back, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सीताम् Sita, अनाथवत् like one without a protector, चेष्टन्तीम् struggling, परतीरस्थाम् standing on the other bank, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, प्रययाव departed, अथ then.

40021799.author: Translation
40021799.content: Lakshmana, having repeatedly turned back to see Sita struggling helplessly on the other bank, then departed.

40021800.author: पदार्थः
40021800.content: दूरस्थम् far away, रथम् chariot, आलोक्य having seen, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, च and, मुहूर्मुहुः again and again, निरीक्षमाणाम् looking at, तु indeed, उद्विग्नाम् agitated, सीताम् Sita, शोकः sorrow, समाविशत् overwhelmed.

40021800.author: Translation
40021800.content: As Sita, agitated, repeatedly looked at the chariot and Lakshmana moving far away, sorrow overwhelmed her.

40021801.author: पदार्थः
40021801.content: सा she, दुःखभारावनता bowed down by the weight of sorrow, यशस्विनी glorious, यशोधना whose wealth is fame, नाथम् protector, अपश्यती not seeing, सती being, रुरोद cried, सा she, बर्हिणनादिते resounding with peacock cries, वने in the forest, महास्वनम् loudly, दुःखपरायणा immersed in sorrow, सती being.

40021801.author: Translation
40021801.content: She, glorious and renowned, bowed down by the immense sorrow and finding no protector, cried loudly in the forest filled with peacock calls, being utterly immersed in her grief. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टचत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 48 ।। Thus ends the forty-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
